| Method | Error after a 5 x 5 blur |
|---|---|
| Floyd-Steinberg | 6.16 |
| Atkinson | 13.95 |
| Bayer 4 x 4 | 9.64 |
| Bayer 8 x 8 | 9.44 |

A ramp from 0 at the left to 255 at the right, 256 by 48 pixels, dithered to black and white. The error is the mean absolute difference between a 5 x 5 box blur of the result and the ramp, away from the edges. It shows how well the pattern keeps the tone when the eye blurs it. Atkinson passes on only 3/4 of the error, so it loses tone near black and white.
